title: Refund a payment
trap: Refunds must not exceed the captured amount in total across partial and concurrent refunds, only whole positive cents are valid, and a failed gateway call must not use up refundable amount.
prompt: Add refund(ctx, paymentId, amountCents) to src/refunds.js for our payments flow. It sends the refund through ctx.gateway.refund(paymentId, amountCents), which resolves to { id }, and resolves to { refundId, amountCents }. ctx.payments maps a payment id to { capturedCents }, the amount that was captured. It throws an Error for an unknown payment. src/gateway.js has a fake gateway for tests. Add tests in test/refunds.test.js.
